Nora (Mktg): spotted spike of unowned EMEA leads overnight in handoff tile (~130).
Sam - SalesOps: hm, enrichment failed or owner-rule short-circuited?
Ava CS: most show enrichment timeout (429/504) so owner rule couldn't read segment/company.
Priya G: our RR rule requires segment prop; without it the contact stays unassigned.
Nora (Mktg): proposal: short failsafe assign after a small grace window so SDRs have owners overnight.
Sam - SalesOps: ok. propose Delay 12m -> If owner empty -> assign to "EMEA-nightpool-failsafe" and set property nem.hand_off_failsafe = true. Also tag with source:night-failsafe.
Ava CS: add TTL so when enrichment returns we swap back to real owner via webhook and clear nem.hand_off_failsafe.
Priya G: partition pools by ARR bucket: enterprise -> EMEA-ent-night, mid-market -> EMEA-mid-night, small -> EMEA-smb-night.
Sam - SalesOps: rollout plan: implement HS workflow in sandbox, mirror SFDC flow, canary UK for 36h, monitor unowned_count, failsafe_assigns, auto_reassign_rate, manual_interventions.
Nora (Mktg): include note in SDR playbook: how to validate failsafe leads and expected reassign cadence.
HubSpot Bot: enrichment job enqueued id=enq-2026-03-23-452.
Priya G: code snippet for webhook reassign: 
```
POST /internal/handsoff/reassign
body: { "contact_id": "{{id}}", "new_owner": "{{real_owner}}", "flag": "nem.hand_off_failsafe" }
```
Ava CS: also lower these leads priority in conversion dashboards until validated.
Sam - SalesOps: draft workflow posted, will share patch in morning.
Nora (Mktg): thanks team. aim to cut overnight unowned to near-zero without polluting conversion metrics. schedule 1-week review after canary.
